title: Version 1.1 Release
description:
Deliver the post-v1.0 release through explicit DAG membership, beginning with the complete profile lifecycle, composition, and upgrade work. This milestone is the strategic home for accepted v1.1 epics; milestone labels describe release intent but do not substitute for dependency-based hierarchy.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The complete profile lifecycle epic is delivered through its approved plan and breakdown on top of the finished v1.0 repository-materialization foundation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every v1.1 child uses canonical long-term architecture and source-of-truth boundaries; no temporary command, adapter, dual format, fallback, compatibility layer, or deferred cleanup is accepted.
- [hard] REQ-03: All attached v1.1 epics and their required gates are effectively terminal before this milestone completes, with release evidence reviewed on the exact integrated candidate.

## Decisions

- D-01: Dependency edges are authoritative for milestone membership; milestone labels are projections and filters only.
- D-02: General profile removal remains deferred beyond v1.1.

## Notes

Additional accepted v1.1 epics may be attached directly to this milestone. Unrelated issues carrying a historical milestone:v1.1 label are not silently adopted without an explicit DAG decision.
